text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day before the race, Symboli Rudolf 
invites Mejiro Ramonu. She asks her to 
share her perspective and dedicate herself 
to the development of the racing world...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ramonu turned down her invitation. 
She told her that if she felt lonely and 
wanted to stand beside her, she should 
step onto the turf herself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day arrives. Taking Mejiro Ramonu's 
words to heart, Symboli Rudolf comes to 
watch the race. Admiring Rudolf, the 
runners burn with fighting spirit.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Surrounded by longing and fighting spirit, 
Mejiro Ramonu heads into the race with the 
Queen's throne on the line—
